title: Estate Operationalization

authorization_baseline.meaning: Canonical repair and superseding launch-authorization baseline

checkout_alias_policy.rule: A Codex-managed local branch named work is permitted only when HEAD is the repository-selected main commit or a descendant of the authorization baseline and the working tree is clean.

launch_prerequisites.description: WP-0678 completion evidence exists and is protected-accepted.
Chief Architect superseding launch authorization exists after canonical repairs.
Steward authorization exists for the protected action classes permitted at launch.
The WP-0697 namespace collision and WP-0701 through WP-0704 topology are authoritatively reconciled.
The execution checkout is the authorization baseline or a verified descendant containing this complete manifest and all activation records.
CAMPAIGN-0670 remains unaccepted; bounded reuse of integrated artifacts is explicitly authorized without inferring acceptance.

verification: Verify git status --porcelain is empty before branch creation.
Verify HEAD contains authorization baseline commit fadea83d678bb50c30cacd62aa12f5c6010b8e02 as an ancestor.
Verify the complete manifest parses as JSON.
Verify every package path listed in this manifest exists.
Verify the authoritative campaign, launch authorization, namespace resolution, and WP-0678 acceptance record exist.
Create or use only campaign/0681-estate-operationalization for campaign implementation.
Verify the CAMPAIGN-0670 bounded-reuse authorization exists and preserves CAMPAIGN-0670 non-acceptance.

WP-0697.rule: The excluded path and its receipt belong to a separate Engineering campaign-execution-enablement lineage and do not complete or accept CAMPAIGN-0681 WP-0697.

packages.title: Estate Operational Current-State and Canonical Reuse Map
packages.objective: Discover and document the existing canonical operational systems, ownership boundaries, reusable seams, conflicts, and prohibited duplicates.
packages.implementation_mode: Repository discovery and bounded implementation as required by the package.
packages.validation_source: The work-package document and affected canonical subsystem tests.

packages.title: Operational State, Event, and Transition Contract
packages.objective: Define the canonical operational state, event, transition, evidence, and authority-aware transition contract.
packages.implementation_mode: Extend existing canonical seams; do not create a competing state store.
packages.validation_source: The work-package document and affected state-transition tests.
completion_requires: Transition model implemented or formally bound to existing canonical state

packages.title: Authority-Aware Operational Action Taxonomy
packages.objective: Classify observation, recommendation, coordination, execution request, mechanical action, office decision, protected decision, and acceptance.
packages.implementation_mode: Reuse existing authority and policy records; do not transfer authority.
packages.validation_source: The work-package document and authority-boundary tests.
completion_requires: Every action class has an explicit authority boundary

packages.title: Resident and Service Health Signal Integration
packages.objective: Integrate existing resident and service-health truth into operational readiness, blocking, degradation, and escalation.
packages.implementation_mode: Consume canonical health signals; do not create a replacement health registry.
packages.validation_source: The work-package document and resident/service-health integration tests.
completion_requires: Healthy, degraded, unavailable, stale, and unknown states are distinguished

packages.title: Campaign and Work-Package Momentum Observer
packages.objective: Observe canonical campaign and work-package state and determine eligible, blocked, degraded, failed, protected, and completed work.
packages.implementation_mode: Read canonical records; do not become a scheduler, dispatch queue, or authority source.
packages.validation_source: The work-package document and momentum-observation tests.
completion_requires: Observation is distinct from recommendation and execution

packages.title: Operational Blocker and Escalation Classifier
packages.objective: Classify dependency, health, evidence, staffing, validation, communication, policy, retry, and protected-authority blockers and route truthful escalation.
packages.implementation_mode: Reuse canonical mailbox and escalation mechanisms.
packages.validation_source: The work-package document and blocker/escalation tests.
completion_requires: Blockers have explicit reason and authority owner

packages.title: Grace Operational Coordination Surface
packages.objective: Give Grace an observable coordination surface without architectural, staffing, merge, deployment, engineering-acceptance, or final authority.
packages.implementation_mode: Extend existing Grace coordination seams and canonical messaging.
packages.validation_source: The work-package document and Grace authority-boundary tests.
completion_requires: Grace can observe and coordinate permitted work

packages.title: Helen Staffing and Capability Request Integration
packages.objective: Integrate explicit staffing and capability requests through Helen's accepted lane without transferring engineering priority, architectural, or acceptance authority.
packages.implementation_mode: Use canonical staffing and capability-request mechanisms.
packages.validation_source: The work-package document and Helen integration tests.
completion_requires: Staffing decisions remain in their proper authority lane

packages.title: Alfred Communication and Mailbox Routing Integration
packages.objective: Use Alfred and canonical mailbox/repository-message mechanisms as operational communication transport without making Alfred execution authority.
packages.implementation_mode: Extend accepted communication seams; do not create a competing mailbox or message bus.
packages.validation_source: The work-package document and mailbox/routing tests.
completion_requires: Routing is distinct from decision and execution authority
Failures and undeliverable messages are visible

packages.title: Engineering Department Operational Integration
packages.objective: Integrate Engineering as one department in the Estate operating model through accepted PTM, Dispatch, validation, evidence, and acceptance seams.
packages.implementation_mode: Preserve CAMPAIGN-0670 engineering standards and existing Engineering authority.
packages.validation_source: The work-package document and Engineering operational-integration tests.
completion_requires: Legacy WP-0697 receipt is not reused
Engineering receives work through accepted mechanisms

packages.title: Readiness, Validation, and Evidence Signal Unification
packages.objective: Unify existing readiness, validation, and evidence signals into truthful operational progression decisions.
packages.implementation_mode: Reuse existing validators and evidence records; do not create competing acceptance truth.
packages.validation_source: The work-package document and readiness/validation/evidence integration tests.
completion_requires: Stale, missing, conflicting, failed, and accepted evidence are distinguished
Progression fails closed when evidence is insufficient

packages.title: Operational Pause, Resume, Retry, and Recovery Controls
packages.objective: Provide deterministic pause, resume, retry, exhaustion, interruption, partial-failure, and checkpoint recovery behavior.
packages.implementation_mode: Extend campaign execution and canonical state mechanisms.
packages.validation_source: The work-package document and pause/resume/retry/recovery tests.
completion_requires: Recovery does not depend on chat or terminal memory

packages.title: Continuous Momentum Engine Bounded Decision Loop
packages.objective: Implement the bounded observe, reconcile, classify, select, recommend or execute, verify, record, checkpoint, and repeat loop.
packages.implementation_mode: Integrate existing canonical state and action seams; do not create an unconstrained autonomous agent.
packages.validation_source: The work-package document and Continuous Momentum Engine tests.
completion_requires: Only explicitly authorized mechanical actions may execute

packages.title: Operational Policy and Guardrail Enforcement
packages.objective: Enforce canonical authority, policy, protected-stop, privacy, staffing, spending, deployment, merge, and acceptance guardrails around operational actions.
packages.implementation_mode: Use existing policy and authority sources; guardrails do not create authority.
packages.validation_source: The work-package document and policy/guardrail tests.

packages.title: Operational Audit Trail and Decision Explainability
packages.objective: Record append-only operational decisions, recommendations, actions, refusals, retries, failures, escalations, checkpoints, and replay evidence.
packages.implementation_mode: Extend accepted evidence and audit seams; do not create competing authority records.
packages.validation_source: The work-package document and audit/explainability/replay tests.
completion_requires: Every decision exposes its inputs and governing rule
Replay is deterministic from safe checkpoints
Evidence is append-only or equivalently tamper-evident

packages.title: Operational Dashboard and Steward Visibility Surface
packages.objective: Provide concise, decision-ready, evidence-backed operational visibility and protected-decision presentation for the Steward.
packages.implementation_mode: Reuse CAMPAIGN-0680 decision-support capabilities where applicable; do not create a competing truth source.
packages.validation_source: The work-package document and dashboard/visibility tests.
completion_requires: Blocked, degraded, failed, protected, and ready states are visible
Protected decisions include evidence and requested authority
Dashboard state is derived from canonical records

packages.title: Operational Acceptance, Graduation, and Campaign Closeout
packages.objective: Define governed operational acceptance readiness, graduation evidence, continuity integration, and campaign closeout without automatic acceptance or closure.
packages.implementation_mode: Use the existing protected acceptance lane and institutional continuity mechanisms.
packages.validation_source: The work-package document and acceptance/graduation/closeout tests.
completion_requires: Readiness is not misrepresented as acceptance
Closeout remains blocked until required authority acts
Continuity and institutional records are produced

packages.title: Failure-Mode, Authority-Boundary, and Degraded-Service Validation
packages.objective: Prove fail-closed behavior across authority violations, stale evidence, degraded services, dependency failures, retry exhaustion, partial failure, and interruption.
packages.implementation_mode: Validate the integrated system without broadening authority.
packages.validation_source: The work-package document and failure-mode validation suite.
completion_requires: Each required failure mode has recorded evidence

packages.title: Bounded Real-Work Pilot Campaign
packages.objective: Run one real but bounded institutional workflow across canonical state, offices, health, readiness, staffing, communications, Engineering, interruption recovery, and protected escalation.
packages.implementation_mode: Pilot only within already authorized operational boundaries.
packages.validation_source: The work-package document, pilot plan, pilot receipts, and pilot validation commands.
completion_requires: Helen and Alfred participate only through proper lanes
Engineering receives executable work through accepted mechanisms
One interruption recovers from a durable checkpoint
One protected decision escalates and is not bypassed
Steward visibility is concise and evidence-backed
No automatic merge, deployment, acceptance, spending, staffing, or disclosure occurs

packages.title: Estate Operationalization Integration and Acceptance
packages.objective: Integrate all campaign results, produce aggregate evidence and the acceptance package, open one campaign pull request, and stop awaiting protected review.
packages.implementation_mode: Aggregate and validate; do not merge or accept.
packages.validation_source: The work-package document, aggregate campaign validation, and all package receipts.
completion_requires: All prior package receipts exist and are internally consistent
Unresolved blockers and residual risks are listed
One campaign pull request is opened
Campaign remains awaiting protected review and acceptance
No automatic merge or acceptance occurs

parallel_groups.condition: Execute in parallel only after WP-0688 and WP-0689 complete and only when owned-path inspection proves collision-free execution.
Execute in parallel only after WP-0690 and WP-0693 complete and only when owned-path inspection proves collision-free execution.

shared_file_rules.canonical_registries: Read-only unless the active work package explicitly grants modification authority.
shared_file_rules.office_charters: Read-only unless the active work package explicitly grants modification authority.
shared_file_rules.completion_receipts: A package may create its own receipt but may not rewrite another package's receipt.
shared_file_rules.shared_runtime_seams: Packages touching the same runtime seam must be sequenced unless exact owned-path analysis proves collision-free execution.
shared_file_rules.namespace_collisions: Exact manifest path and campaign identity control. Numeric identifier alone is insufficient.

minimum_campaign_checks: Run all package-specific tests named by each work package
Verify all listed completion receipts exist before WP-0707
Verify no automatic merge, deployment, acceptance, spending, staffing, or disclosure occurred

final_deliverables: Implemented and tested bounded Continuous Momentum Engine integrated with canonical Estate state and action seams.
Communication routing and office coordination evidence.
Pause, resume, retry, interruption, and recovery evidence.
Audit, explainability, checkpoint, and replay evidence.
Operational dashboard and Steward visibility evidence.
One bounded real-work pilot with receipts.
Completion receipts and gate evidence for WP-0688 through WP-0707.
One campaign pull request containing the complete campaign change set.
Final report listing branch, authorization baseline, package commits, validations, gate decisions, pilot results, unresolved blockers, residual risks, and protected decisions awaiting human action.
